contract_ref: EV-ABS-1 — Absence is valid information; missing capabilities are not failures. However, when a capability IS present and produces incorrect results, that is a violation.

derivation_chain.step: Field name mismatch between pointer schema and validator expectation constitutes contract drift

finding.title: Pointer contract mismatch — field name drift between pointer and validator
finding.description: Workspace .librarian/current-project.json uses 'project_id' but validate-startup-registry-selection.py expects 'active_project_id'. This is cross-component contract drift between the pointer producer and the pointer consumer.
finding.invariant_violated: Pointer field names must be consistent between producer and consumer
finding.impact: Validator cannot validate pointer structure; pointer-based project selection is unverifiable

recommendation.description: Align pointer schema: either update current-project.json to use 'active_project_id' or update the validator to accept 'project_id'. The choice should be formalized as a schema contract.
recommendation.proposed_action: Owner decision required — which field name is canonical?
